messages:
Ana: Uploaded new Spend card mockups — compact header, org/project switch, stacked-month bars, small invoice preview. PTAL: https://figma.com/mock123
Jon: Default to Org for billing users, but persist last-scope per user. Admins can pin default in settings.
Sam: Stacked bar better perf than area. If legend overlays the chart we need responsive behavior for mobile.
Rina: Token buckets proposed: Prompt, Completion, Embedding, Rerank. Must match billing export names exactly. I'll share mapping.
Eli: Finance needs CSV with invoice_id,billing_account_id,project_id,date,tokens,cost_usd. Also a quick "Export invoice mapping" button would help.
Ana: Copy tweak: change title to "Estimated billed spend (USD)" and tooltip: "Estimate based on recorded usage and pricing; final charges are on invoices."
Sam: a11y check: legend small text + pale fills may fail contrast. a11y-bot, scan colors?
a11y-bot: Palette scan: mid-blue #4178D6 fails AA for normal text. Recommend darker text or patterned fills. Also ensure keyboard focus for points and aria-describedby on tooltips.
Rina: For colorblind support we can add patterns to fills; will attach examples.
Jon: Rollout behind flag spend_insights_v2. Start at 5% orgs, admin opt-in. Track dashboard vs invoice variance closely.
Ana: I'll update figma with pattern fills and a compact control set, then tag everyone. Thanks!
